recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, macro photograph of a yellow and black swallowtail butterfly that has been physically separated into three distinct parts—two wings and a central body—pinned to a textured, off-white surface with light blue specimen pins. A vertical seam or wire bisects the composition slightly off-center.
coreVisualRelationships: The central body acts as a pivot point between the detached wings.
The vertical line creates a subtle tension and division between the right wing and the rest of the subject.
The light blue pins provide a cool-toned focal contrast to the warm yellow wings.
The typography is anchored in the top right quadrant, balancing the visual weight of the butterfly.
coreInvariants: The butterfly must be physically separated into three parts.
The wings must be yellow with black tiger-stripe patterns.
The background must have a gritty, matte, plaster-like texture.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The deconstructed butterfly is centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 60% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central body of the butterfly, being the smallest and most isolated element.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the vibrant yellow wings, move inward to the central body, then upward to the vertical line and the text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample off-white negative space surrounds the subject, emphasizing the clinical, specimen-like presentation.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow wings against a low-saturation, high-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to yellow, black, off-white, and pale blue

letterConstructionRules: The primary title is lowercase, ultra-light geometric sans-serif with wide tracking.
The secondary title is a small, italicized, high-contrast serif or script.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'p' and 'a' in the main text have perfectly circular counters.
The 'm' has a consistent width with the other characters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a modern, clean sans-serif and a traditional, delicate italic script.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric lowercase aesthetic and circular counters.
Provides the necessary geometric purity and thin strokes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution macro photo of a yellow and black swallowtail butterfly separated into three pieces (two wings, one body) pinned to a textured off-white plaster wall with three light blue pins. Include a thin vertical black wire or seam running top to bottom, slightly right of center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the top right corner, add two lines of text aligned to the right. The top line should be a small italic script. The bottom line should be a large, thin, lowercase geometric sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the butterfly separated into three distinct parts?
Is the text in the top right corner right-aligned?
Is the background texture visible and matte?
Are there three light blue pins present?

adjustableVariables: Wing color (e.g., orange instead of yellow)
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific band name or album title text.
Do not replicate the exact wing tear patterns; use unique organic damage.
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the vertical line does not overlap the butterfly body.
Check that the text is legible against the background texture.
Verify the 'pinned' look includes subtle shadows under the wings.
Confirm the color of the pins is a distinct pale blue.
recipe.reuseFormula: Deconstructed [Subject] + Specimen Pins + Textured Neutral Background + Right-Aligned Geometric Typography
